comment: What release/sync.py copies from the development repositories into this public repository. Only files committed in a development repository can be copied; these patterns then leave some of them out. Everything is checked by the privacy and size checks below before anything is written.

why_excluded..github/**: the workflows of this repository are in its own .github/ at the top
why_excluded.docs/records/**: dated notes of the development, such as a page-redesign delivery note: kept by the owner

why_excluded.records/**: measurement records, hand-offs and the task briefs of the development: kept by the owner, available on request
why_excluded.docs/history/**: dated reports of earlier versions: kept by the owner, available on request
why_excluded.scripts/report_task4b.py: wrote a dated report now in docs/history/
